metadata.method: Fresh emulator process for every native ROM boot; no state loads or memory patches. Uniform sampling of menu delays 3000..3599 without replacement within each version. Blocks of five flights per version, randomized order within block. Centered joystick; first A32E entry, 170 video frames warmup, count B516 intervals until >=60 seconds. Checkpoints at >=15 and >=30 seconds are nested, not independent samples.
